facts.statement: IIR is 8-bit read-only register at bus address 2 to get interrupt information
facts.quote: Interrupt Identification 2 8 R Get interrupt information

facts.statement: IIR bit 0 value 0 indicates interrupt pending
facts.quote: Bit 0 indicates that an interrupt is pending when it’s logic ‘0’.

facts.statement: IIR bit 0 value 1 indicates no interrupt pending
facts.quote:
When it’s ‘1’ – no interrupt
is pending.

facts.statement: IIR reports current highest priority pending interrupt
facts.quote:
The IIR enables the programmer to retrieve what is the current highest priority pending
interrupt.

facts.statement: IIR bits 3-1 value 011 is 1st priority Receiver Line Status
IIR bits 3-1 value 010 is 2nd priority Receiver Data available
IIR bits 3-1 value 110 is 2nd priority Timeout Indication
IIR bits 3-1 value 001 is 3rd priority Transmitter Holding Register empty
IIR bits 3-1 value 000 is 4th priority Modem Status
facts.quote: 0 0 0 4 th Modem Status CTS, DSR, RI or DCD. Reading the Modem

facts.statement: Receiver Line Status source is parity overrun framing errors or break
Receiver Line Status is reset by reading Line Status Register
Receiver Data source is FIFO trigger reached and reset when FIFO drops below trigger
facts.quote:
FIFO trigger level reached FIFO drops below
trigger level

facts.statement: Timeout source is at least 1 character in FIFO with no input or read for last 4 char times
facts.quote:
There’s at least 1 character
in the FIFO but no character
has been input to the FIFO
or read from it for the last 4
Char times.

facts.statement: Timeout is reset by reading Receiver Buffer Register
facts.quote:
Reading from the
FIFO (Receiver
Buffer Register)

facts.statement: THR empty is reset by writing Transmitter Holding Register or reading IIR
facts.quote:
Writing to the
Transmitter Holding
Register or reading
IIR.

facts.statement: Modem Status is reset by reading Modem status register
IIR bits 7-6 are fixed to 1 for compatibility
facts.quote: Bits 6 and 7: Logic ‘1’ for compatibility reason.

sequences.purpose: READ IIR address 2 after reset to capture no-pending baseline
RE-READ IIR address 2 after reset control to observe pending clear or next highest priority
